verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance use-case page says data is 'easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports', and it markets an HR and workforce planning use case. That points to first-party data connectors and headcount planning on the same platform. However, no payroll/HRIS or CRM connector is named, and the Agent Connectors (Notion, Drive, Slack) give AI agents context rather than importing model data. missing for 10: named HRIS/payroll connectors (e.g., Workday, ADP), named CRM connectors (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), documentation of headcount and pipeline data landing in the same model as GL/actuals, independent or hands-on corroboration.
